tax.text: Flood says he voted to cut taxes for Nebraska families and to pass No Tax on Tips, Overtime, and Social Security.
tax.quote: I voted to cut taxes for Nebraska families. I voted to pass No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and No Tax on Social Security.

trade.text: Flood said the president and Congress should use every lawful tool available to build a resilient domestic economy and help American goods compete abroad after the Supreme Court’s tariffs ruling.
trade.quote: I trust that President Trump and Congress will use every lawful tool available to keep growing our economy and ensure American goods compete on a level playing field abroad.

housing.text: Flood wrote a bill to cut red tape and make it cheaper to build new homes.
housing.quote: My bill cuts red tape and makes it more affordable to build new homes.

safety.text: Flood helped secure federal funding for police cruisers, sheriff’s equipment, body cameras and increased Drug Enforcement Administration funding.
safety.quote: $1,200,000 to the Lancaster County Sheriff’s Office equipment and body-worn cameras.

immigration.text: Flood voted to fund Border Patrol and immigration enforcement and said people in the country illegally who commit crimes should be removed.
immigration.quote: I voted to fund Border Patrol and immigration enforcement

guns.text: Flood says he will oppose any attempt to infringe on the right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: I will oppose any attempt to infringe on Americans' fundamental liberties, including our freedoms of speech and religion and our sacred right to keep and bear arms.

abortion.text: Flood describes himself as a pro-life champion who believes life begins at conception.
abortion.quote: Life is a precious gift from God that begins at conception. I've been a pro-life champion in the Legislature

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Flood voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, saying athletics should be based on biological sex.
gender.quote: Helping young Americans participate in athletics based on their biological sex is just common sense.

cannabis.text: Flood opposed helping reclassify marijuana federally and said he would not advocate for medical marijuana beyond complying with Nebraska law.
cannabis.quote: I am not going to use my advocacy efforts to help reclassify marijuana at the federal level,” Flood said.

health.text: Flood said he supported extending expired Obamacare subsidies but voted against a proposal because it did not include reforms to reduce waste, fraud, and abuse.
health.quote: I support an extension of the subsidies but not without reforms, including the elimination of waste, fraud, and abuse

energy.text: Flood says he opposes the Green New Deal, mileage taxes, and carbon taxes.
energy.quote: I oppose the Green New Deal, mileage taxes, carbon taxes

voting.text: Flood supports voter ID and says election laws should ensure that legal ballots are counted accurately.
voting.quote: I support commonsense measures, like voter ID, that will better secure future elections and give voters the confidence that legal ballots will be counted accurately.

tax.text: Backemeyer calls for rebalancing the tax code so the wealthy pay more and expanding the Child Tax Credit to fund relief for families.
tax.quote: Rebalance the tax code so that billionaires and corporations pay their fair share

trade.text: Backemeyer wants to end tariffs, saying they harm Nebraska farmers and raise costs for producers and consumers.
trade.quote: End the tariff chaos that harms farmers and raises consumer costs

housing.text: Backemeyer proposes cutting regulatory delays on housing projects to get more families into homes.
housing.quote: Cut red tape that delays housing projects and puts families in houses instead of investment firms

immigration.text: Backemeyer supports comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship and clawing back ICE funding.
immigration.quote: Pass comprehensive immigration reform that creates a genuine pathway to citizenship and keeps families together

abortion.text: Backemeyer says he will protect abortion access in Nebraska and nationally.
abortion.quote: Protect a woman's right to choose in Nebraska and nationwide

health.text: Backemeyer supports enacting a public option to guarantee universal coverage and lowering the Medicare eligibility age to 60.
health.quote: Enact a true public option to guarantee universal coverage and force insurance companies to compete by offering lower prices and better coverage

abortion.text: Sandman said he opposes abortion and supported legislation requiring care for babies born alive after failed abortion attempts while opposing taxpayer funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: Nik Sandman, a Libertarian, told Nebraska Public Media News that he is most passionate about life, including supporting health care for all and pushing against abortion and euthanasia.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: On a candidate questionnaire, Sandman answered "Yes" to legislation limiting girls' sports and women's facilities to those born female, and "No" to sex-change surgeries for minors.
gender.quote: Do you support legislation prohibiting men from playing in girls' sports and using women's restrooms and locker rooms?

health.text: Sandman said the government should fund and build health care infrastructure and allow people to use it, describing this as health care for all.
health.quote: He compared how he believes the government should provide health care to the way it provides roads — the government should fund and build them and allow people the freedom to use them.
